maria-support: Customer cust-552 reported embeddings length changed after we pinned model to v2. Previously returned 1536, now 1024 for the exact same input. Downstream indexer is failing.
kevin-eng: :eyes: which pinned identifier did they lock to? model param they sent?
maria-support: They pinned `redwood-embed-large@2026-03-01` via the Console and via the API. Attaching sample request below.
maria-support: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large@2026-03-01","input":"test document"}'
```
ashley-ml: Can you paste the raw embedding length or the first 8 values? Also is there any proxy or gateway doing batching/altering requests?
maria-support: Raw response shows "data":[{"embedding":[...1024 numbers...] }] so length is 1024. Customer insists no client change.
kevin-eng: Two quick hypotheses: 1) variant fallback to a smaller/quantized variant under reserved capacity, 2) batching/batchpad could be routing requests to a different runtime shim. Any request headers like `x-redwood-model-tag`?
maria-support: Headers the customer included: `x-redwood-model-tag: pinned-v2`, `x-request-id: req_99aab`. They are on Dedicated/reserved capacity.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: pinned deployment 'redwood-embed-large@2026-03-01' was updated (artifact hash changed) at 4365105000.

ashley-ml: Quick local check command: `jq '.data[0].embedding | length' response.json` — see whether it returns 1024.
maria-support: Customer reported temporary workaround: repinned to older tag `redwood-embed-large@2026-02-20` and restored 1536-length embeddings. They need guidance and rollback option.
kevin-eng: Advise customer to repin to that tag for now — we'll escalate. I'll open INC-552 and attach deployment logs and artifact diffs. :+1:
